evidence.citation: Artifact: "Repeat the same blind evaluation 2–3 times, using a fresh, context-free agent for every run" and "After each run, sweep the live checkout for leaked changes and clean them" and "Re-evaluate every case after any revision to detect regressions."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s added work is aimed at reproducibility, isolation, leak detection, and regression checking before a durable claim. Under the supplied bar, those controls are necessary rather than materially unnecessary.
